data.name: Rohit baghel
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Rohit baghel has made a big mark in cricket. With 27 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 59*, with an average of 16.89 and a quick strike rate of 169.83. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 28 sixes and 20 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 101.0 overs, taking 45 wickets at an economy rate of 7.30. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
